Mo asks Frank if she can go to a slumber party at Morgan’s house.

title: Moesha
description:
S3 E23 — A House Is Not A Home
Moesha is living with Andell after having moved out of Frank & Dee’s home.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E1 — Moesha Meets Brandy
Moesha meets Brandy at a concert and we discover that Moesha is having a romance with Aaron, a college student.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E2 — Homecoming
With a little help from Myles and a visit from Grandma Mitchell, Moesha moves back home and returns to Crenshaw High.

S2 E3 — Pillow Talk
When Mary reluctantly agrees to partner with Sandra in the pillow-making business, she finds herself doing all the work--with Sandra reaping all the 'benefits.'.

S2 E4 — Mary Nightingale
Lester turns into a real pain for Mary when he comes home from work early complaining of a stomach ache, but when she sneaks out for a pedicure, Lester is stricken with appendicitis--leaving Sandra to care for him.

S2 E5 — The Great Man Hunt
Alarmed that her biological clock is winding down, Sandra sets out to find a perfect husband to father her child, but when she strikes out with the available men, she decides to have a baby anyway--regardless of her marital status.

S2 E6 — Got A Job
Anxious to become an adult, Brenda (Regina King) takes on part-time work, but soon discovers learning how to juggle all her responsibilities is a full-time job.

title: Malcolm & Eddie

Ticket scalping gets Malcolm and Eddie jailed on the eve of Martin Luther King Day.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

An unruly customer challenges Eddie to a fight; Nicolette and Holly try being roommates.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E16 — Jugglin'
While trying to help Holly, Malcolm finds himself juggling three dates at the same time.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E17 — Everynight Fever
Eddie's new band jeopardizes his work at the garage.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E18 — The Commercial
A TV commercial inadvertently turns Malcolm McGee's into a gay bar.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E6 — We Were Robbed
Fred covers his clumsiness by proclaiming 'we were robbed' and he turns into a boastful hero cited for bravery. But Lamont finds the shattered remains of his prized porcelain and glass collection and decides to teach his father a lesson.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E7 — A Pad For Lamont
Angered by his father's constant interruption of his dates, Lamont moves out to pursue the life of a swinging bachelor. But much to Lamont's disappointment, it's the newly unchaperoned Fred who is besieged by the ladies.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E8 — Great Sanford Siege
Fred's failure to pay any bills brings threats of turned off utilities and repossessed furniture. But when the collection agents come to take away the furniture, the quick thinking Fred turns a fall into a fast fortune.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E9 — Coffins For Sale
Lamont buys two coffins at an auction and is determined to sell them at a large profit. Very superstitious about having coffins in the house, Fred decides to sleep in the back of the truck until they are sold.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E10 — The Barracuda
Lamont strongly objects to his father's proposal of marriage to the widow Donna Harris (Lynn Hamilton). Lamont's protestations that no one can take the place of his mother leads to a heated three?way argument and one fiery exit.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E11 — Tv Or Not Tv
Fred wants a color television and Lamont wants a car, but they can't afford both. Fred, enraged to learn that Lamont went ahead and bought the car, ends up in the hospital with amnesia, a very sympathetic son and a suspicious twinkle in his eye.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E7 — Me And Billy Dee
Billy Dee Williams makes a guest appearance in the Jefferson living room, but can't convince his 'number one fan' Florence that he is who he is.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E8 — Half A Brother
George's attempts to make points with a local banker are frustrated by Allan's attempts to make points with the banker's daughter.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E9 — What Are Friends For?
George agonizes over a decision that could change both his life and the life of someone very special. George's favorite cousin, Dusty, delights the Jeffersons with a surprise visit, but concerns them with some serious news.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E10 — George Who?
Louise insists that she and George have fallen into a rut, until a turn of fate transforms their 'routine' into the good old days.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S5 E11 — Harry's House Guest
Harry Bentley is stuck with an insufferable lady houseguest and when George Jefferson volunteers to get him unstuck, he winds up sticking Bentley with something worse.
